lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Halfway up the ridge road stands a cairn of black stones, older than the road.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Words are cut into the top stone, worn almost smooth: ONE EDGE, BROKEN TEN WAYS.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: Ten ways. Ten blades. You were one sword once.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: I was a piece of one. The whole of it was hungry, and the world was small.

lines.speaker: blade
lines.text: People who are dust now. Smoke on the ridge. Deserters. Go and be useful.
